findings.finding: The definition first identifies natural-deduction derivations as trees of sentences, then says a sentence may stand below one, two or three other sequents.
findings.controlling_evidence: The same paragraph calls every top node and every premise or conclusion a sentence, and every displayed natural-deduction rule connects sentence formulas rather than sequents.
findings.required_translation_handling: Replace the mistaken node type by sentences and add an adjacent OLTEND-001 note.

findings.finding: The intermediate tree combines not-A and A to false but labels the step with Intro{false} rather than Elim{not}.
findings.controlling_evidence: The immediately preceding prose explicitly names Elim{not}, the rule list defines that exact two-premise inference, and the later completed version of the same branch labels it Elim{not}.
findings.required_translation_handling: Use Elim{not} on that one tree step, retain all formulas and discharge labels, and add an adjacent OLTEND-002 note.

findings.finding: The prose locates the principal sentence in an end-sequent even though this chapter's derivations have a conclusion sentence rather than a sequent.
findings.controlling_evidence: OLP-0085 and OLP-0088 define natural-deduction derivations as sentence trees with a bottommost conclusion; no sequent is introduced in this chapter.
findings.required_translation_handling: Refer to the sentence in the conclusion and add an adjacent OLTEND-003 note.

findings.finding: The structure noun is outside the FOL tag, whose non-FOL branch supplies a valuation symbol, producing the ill-typed phrase structure v in the propositional rendering.
findings.controlling_evidence: Every surrounding soundness case branches between an FOL structure M and a propositional valuation v, and the satisfaction macro in the same sentence is tag-selected accordingly.
findings.required_translation_handling: Move the structure token into the FOL branch, use native valuation wording in the propositional branch, preserve both symbols and add an adjacent OLTEND-004 note.
